test_title: PYST 17: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 15 Oct, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Select the sentence that has a grammatical error.

options.text: She always cuts out unhealthy snacks.
The manager cuts the discussion to address an urgent matter.
Can you cut through the traffic to get here on time?
They need to cut down the old tree in the garden.

solution:
The erroneous sentence is: The manager cuts the discussion to address an urgent matter. .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence in** option 2 **has a grammatical error.
 
• It should use **"cut short"** instead of just **"cuts"** to convey the meaning of interrupting or ending the discussion prematurely.

Correct sentence: *The manager cuts short the discussion to address an urgent matter.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Examples of Correct Usage of "cut":**

 
 
• **Cut out:** She always cuts out unhealthy snacks.
 
• **Cut through:** Can you cut through the traffic to get here on time?
 
• **Cut down:** They need to cut down the old tree in the garden.
